season_overview.title: IIT Bombay Campus Placement Season Masterplan & Recruitment Calendar

months_overview.title: Season Kickoff & Master CV Locking

key_milestones.title: Official Placement Season 2025-26 Kickoff Broadcast
Degree Conversion & Dual Degree Preference Forms
Master CV Verification Portal Opens

months_overview.tactical_guidance: Lock your 1-page (SDE/Quant) and 2-page (Consulting/Core) LaTeX resumes with verified proofs. Any unverified project bullet point will lead to immediate portal debarment.

months_overview.title: Orientation Talks & Masterclasses
months_overview.theme: SARC Core Talks & Cantilever Labs Prep Masterclasses

key_milestones.title: Resume Making Sessions by Cantilever Labs
SARC Alumni Core Talks Kickoff
Finance & Quant Knowledge Sessions
Formal Suit Stalls Reminder & Fittings

months_overview.tactical_guidance: Establish a peer case group for Consulting (3 people) and start daily 2-hour LeetCode medium problem sets for Tech. Complete suit fittings early to avoid late November tailoring rushes.

months_overview.title: Corporate PPTs & Institute Preparatory Tests
months_overview.theme: Top Firm PPTs (Flipkart, Kearney) & Diagnostic Tests

key_milestones.title: Cantilever Labs Consulting Case Masterclass
Institute Preparatory Test (IPT) Set 1 [(DSA+OS+DBMS)]
Institute Preparatory Test (IPT) Set 2 [(DSA+Aptitude+Finance)]
Kearney Pre-Placement Talk (PPT Attendance Mandatory)
Flipkart Corporate Pre-Placement Talk (PPT)

months_overview.tactical_guidance: Treat IPT tests as real Day 1 tests. They give you your true campus rank across 1,600+ candidates. PPT attendance for Kearney, McKinsey, and BCG is strictly tracked for shortlisting eligibility.

months_overview.title: The Online Assessment (OA) Surge
months_overview.theme: Nightly Tests (8 PM - 11 PM), 157 JAFs & Window Collisions

key_milestones.title: Da Vinci Pre-Placement Talk & Quant Test Intro
Kearney JAF Opens (48-hour submission window)
Sony Japan & Squarepoint Capital JAFs Open
Flipkart APM-1 Problem Statement Released (72-hour window)
Google India Pre-Placement Talk & OA Registration
Peak Nightly OA Wave: 2-3 Tests Every Night from 8:00 PM to 11:30 PM

months_overview.tactical_guidance: CRITICAL: Back-to-back 8 PM & 10 PM test fatigue is the #1 reason strong candidates fail OAs. Follow our 15-Minute Brain Wash protocol. Never attempt 24-hr weekend tests on Sunday night after 10 PM due to portal server congestion.

months_overview.title: Peak Shortlist Drops & Slot Matrix Preview
months_overview.theme: Surprise Shortlist Drops, 277 JAFs & D-Day Slotting Finalization

key_milestones.title: First Wave Tech & Quant Test Shortlists Released
IDC Day 1 Companies Roster Announced
Bain & Company & Top Tier-1 Shortlists Drop
Google & Microsoft Interview Rosters Finalized
Official Day 1.1 and Day 1.2 Slotting Matrix Released

months_overview.tactical_guidance: Shortlists drop between midnight and 2:00 AM. Do not panic if your name isn't on Day 1.1 rosters; Day 1.2, Day 2.1, and Day 2.2 hold over 60% of all campus tech and consulting hiring.

months_overview.title: D-Day Interviews (Day 1.1 to Day 15)
months_overview.theme: The 15-Day Battle: Rapid Slots, Selections & Walk-in Rounds

key_milestones.title: Day 1.1 Kickoff: Jane Street, Optiver, Apple, Google, Qualcomm
Day 1.2 Kickoff: McKinsey, BCG, Bain, Goldman Sachs, ITC
Day 2 Sprint: Flipkart, Meesho, Zomato, Micron, NK Securities Walk-ins
Days 3 to 8: Bulk Core Engineering (Tata, Reliance, SLB) & Analytics
Phase 1 Conclusion & Extended Wave Selections

months_overview.tactical_guidance: Stay in interview holding lounges. Keep in close touch with your Department Placement Coordinator (DPC) runner. Over 40 companies issue instant walk-in shortlists when earlier candidates accept offers.

oa_survival_guide.title: October Online Assessment (OA) Overlap & Fatigue Survival Guide
oa_survival_guide.description: In October, 92 Online Assessments take place across HackerRank, Mercer Mettl, and SHL, alongside 157 JAF deadlines and academic midsem exams. This tactical playbook helps candidates navigate back-to-back testing and mental fatigue.

consecutive_test_strategy.rule: The 15-Minute Brain Wash (Between 8:00 PM and 9:45 PM Tests)
consecutive_test_strategy.action: Never carry disappointment from a missed test case in the 8:00 PM test into the 9:45 PM test. Immediately close your laptop, wash your face with cold water, do 5 minutes of box breathing, and drink cold water with electrolytes. Reset your mental score to zero.

consecutive_test_strategy.rule: Neural Context Switching (SDE Coding → Quant/Analytics Math)
consecutive_test_strategy.action: Switching from writing C++ algorithms to speed mental math requires different brain regions. Before starting a Quant/Analytics test, solve 3 quick mental arithmetic drills (multiplications / Bayes percentages) to activate your numerical intuition.

If you are stuck on problem 3 with 15 minutes remaining, stop attempting an optimal O(N) solution. Implement a clean brute-force O(N²) or O(2^N) solution to capture 30–50% partial points. In campus hiring, partial test cases often differentiate who gets shortlisted.

weekend_window_strategy.window_type: 24-Hour Open Window Assessments (Saturday 12 PM - Sunday 12 PM)
weekend_window_strategy.golden_rule: NEVER take the test between 10:00 PM and 11:59 PM on Sunday.
weekend_window_strategy.why: Historically, over 600 students attempt the test in the final 2 hours. HackerRank and Mettl servers experience severe latency spikes, code execution delays (queue times jump from 2s to 90s), and submission timeout failures.
weekend_window_strategy.best_time_to_start: Saturday 10:30 AM – 1:00 PM or Sunday 2:00 PM – 4:30 PM when mental alertness is high and platform bandwidth is free.

traps_to_avoid: Multi-monitor detection: Disconnect external HDMI cables completely before starting.
Clipboard tracking: Never paste external code. HackerRank logs keystroke cadence and paste volume.
Tab switching: Any window blur of >3 seconds triggers an automated integrity flag to the campus recruiter.
Lighting traps: Ensure bright, uniform frontal lighting. Side shadows trigger 'No Face Detected' or 'Multiple Faces Detected' flags.
Audio sensitivity: Ambient hostel corridor noise or fans can trigger suspicious noise warnings. Test in a quiet room with the door locked.
Eye tracking: Looking away from the screen for >5 seconds generates an alert.
No question backtracking: Once you submit an answer or skip, you CANNOT go back. If stuck, make an educated guess.
No negative marking: Never leave an SHL aptitude question blank before the timer expires.

midsem_fatigue_recovery: Take a mandatory 45-minute power nap between 5:30 PM and 6:30 PM before evening tests.
Selective JAF signing: Do not sign 120 JAFs blindly. An unattempted test after signing a JAF incurs placement cell penalty points. Target 35–50 high-conviction companies.
Keep high-protein snacks (walnuts, almonds, dark chocolate) on your desk. Avoid heavy oily hostel dinners before 8:00 PM.

dday_slotting_playbook.title: D-Day (Dec 1–15) Slotting & Multi-Shortlist Playbook
dday_slotting_playbook.description: How IIT Bombay orchestrates the premier recruiting slots, and how candidates navigate multi-shortlist collisions and walk-in rounds.

slots.prestige: Premier Global HFTs & Tier-1 Tech Titans
slots.characteristics: Highest compensation on campus (₹1 Cr to ₹2.5+ Cr). Fastest round pacing (30–45 mins per technical panel).
slots.collision_strategy: You can physically attend at most 2–3 full interview loops before 3:00 PM. Prioritize the firm where your OA percentile and interviewer rapport was highest.

slots.prestige: Global Management Consultancies, Tier-1 FinTech & Premier Core
slots.characteristics: Premier consulting firms (McKinsey, BCG, Bain) and elite investment banks (Goldman Sachs, Morgan Stanley). Multi-partner case interviews.
slots.collision_strategy: Consulting interviews require rapid mental switching between case rounds and partner fits. If dual-shortlisted with tech/fintech, take the consulting round first as their partner panels have fixed schedules.

slots.timing: December 2: Day (08:00 AM – 04:00 PM) & Night (05:00 PM – 01:00 AM)
slots.prestige: High-Growth Unicorns, E-Commerce Giants & Top Core
slots.characteristics: Massive hiring velocity. Companies issue offers rapidly to prevent candidates from taking Day 3 slots.
slots.collision_strategy: Look for extended shortlists. Day 2 companies often promote waitlisted candidates if Day 1 candidates accept earlier offers.

slots.timing: December 3 – 15: Rolling Daily Slots (12:00 PM – 08:00 PM)
slots.prestige: Core Engineering, Analytics, Enterprise SaaS & PSUs
slots.characteristics: Consistent daily hiring. Core engineering departments (Mech, Civil, Chem, Aero) see their peak selections during this period.
slots.collision_strategy: Keep your stamina high. Selections here are steady and reliable. Never let down your guard during HR and behavioral rounds.

collision_rules.scenario: Shortlisted in two companies in the same slot (e.g. Google and Qualcomm in Day 1.1)
collision_rules.protocol: Notify your Department Placement Coordinator (DPC) at 6:30 AM. The DPC runners will sequence your panels so you complete Round 1 of Company A, then attend Round 1 of Company B while Company A deliberates.

collision_rules.scenario: Receiving an offer while waiting for another interview
collision_rules.protocol: The 1-Offer Rule is absolute: as soon as Company A registers your offer in the placement system, you are placed and automatically withdrawn from Company B.

If Company X has 5 open slots and 3 shortlisted candidates get placed elsewhere in earlier slots, Company X issues an 'Extended Shortlist' on the spot. Candidates on the waitlist are called for instant interviews.

consulting.title: Management Consulting & Strategy
consulting.key_advice: Attendance at Kearney, McKinsey, and BCG PPTs in September is strictly monitored. Buddy rounds run throughout November; practice cases out loud with peers, not by reading casebooks silently.
consulting.timeline_pattern: PPTs in late Sept → JAFs early Oct → Buddy rounds in Nov → Day 1.2 Interviews (Dec 1 night)

sde.title: Software Engineering (SDE)
sde.key_advice: October has 92 OAs. 80% test standard Dynamic Programming, Graph Traversal, and Trees. Master 60-minute timed sprints under HackerRank proctoring conditions.
sde.timeline_pattern: Early JAFs in Sept/Oct → Massive OA surge Oct 10-31 → Shortlists mid-Nov → Day 1.1 & Day 2 Interviews

quant.title: Quantitative Finance & Trading (HFT)
quant.key_advice: Accuracy and speed are everything. Practice 80-question speed math tests (Zetamac). Master Bayes theorem, Markov chains, and expected value puzzles.
quant.timeline_pattern: Da Vinci / Squarepoint PPTs in early Oct → Mettl speed math tests in late Oct → Day 1.1 Interviews (Dec 1, 7 AM)

core.title: Core Engineering & FMCG
core.key_advice: Be ready to draw diagrams and derive equations on paper. Panelists focus on your summer internship and BTP design choices.
core.timeline_pattern: SARC Core Talks in Aug → JAFs in Oct/Nov → Days 3-8 Interviews (Dec 3-8 peak selections)

analytics.title: Product Management, Analytics & AI/ML
analytics.key_advice: Flipkart APM problem statement drops in mid-October with a strict 72-hour turnaround. Expect live SQL tests with window functions.
analytics.timeline_pattern: APM Assignment drops mid-Oct → SQL OAs in Nov → Day 1.2 / Day 2 Interviews
